CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
February 12, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

6.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE HISTORICAL PRESERVATION ADVISORY COUNCIL – It is recommended the City Council appoint Harry Scott to the Historical Preservation Advisory Council.
6.1 Appointment to HPAC
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of January 22, 2019.
7.1 Minutes of January 22, 2019
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated February 12, 2019 in the total amount of $2,094,122.23.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING DECEMBER 2018 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending December 2018.
7.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.4
CITY OF LA MIRADA FINANCIAL TRANSACTIONS REPORT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2017-18 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Financial Transactions Report for Fiscal Year 2017-18.
7.4 Financial Transactions Report for FY 2017-18
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-03, MEASURE I, PHASE 5, RESIDENTIAL STREET REHABILITATION – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-03, Measure I, Phase 5, Residential Street Rehabilitation, to R.J. Noble Company in the amount of $7,932,019; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed ten percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction and construction survey, testing and inspection.
7.5 CIP No. 2017-03
7.6
AGREEMENT WITH THEATER DIRECT, INC. FOR TELEMARKETING SERVICES FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve a professional services agreement with Theater Direct, Inc. for telemarketing services for the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.6 Agreement with Theater Direct, Inc.
7.7
LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE SERVICES FOR PARKS AND FACILITIES – REVIEW OF PROPOSALS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract to So Cal Land Maintenance, Inc. for landscape maintenance services for parks and facilities and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any required extensions to the contract on behalf of the City.
7.7 Landscape Maintenance Services for Parks and Facilities
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 706 AMENDING REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO DANGEROUS FIREWORKS, AND AMENDING TITLE 16 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 706 amending regulations applicable to dangerous fireworks and amending Title 16 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.1 Ordinance No. 706 - Second Reading
8.2
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 707 ADDING A NEW CHAPTER 4.70 TO THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE TO CREATE A SIDEWALK VENDING PROGRAM – It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 707 adding a new Chapter 4.70 to the La Mirada Municipal Code to create a sidewalk vending program, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.2 Ordinance No. 707 - First Reading
9.

9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-03 APPROVING THE CITY AS A PASSPORT ACCEPTANCE FACILITY AND ESTABLISHING A PASSPORT EXECUTION FEE – It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as required by law and adopt Resolution No. 19-03 approving the City as a Passport Acceptance Facility and establishing a Passport Execution Fee.
9.1 Resolution No. 19-03
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 19-04 ESTABLISHING A FEE FOR A SIDEWALK VENDING PERMIT - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as required by law and adopt Resolution No. 19-04 establishing a fee for a sidewalk vending permit.
9.2 Resolution No. 19-04
